name: Idempotent Update - Ensure Complete Folder Structure
description: Extend fade update to ensure any FADE project has complete folder structure. The principle: fade update should be idempotent - it brings any FADE project up to current spec, non-destructively. Never overwrites existing files, never deletes anything, only fills gaps and reports what was created.

userStories.title: Create fade/tests/ folder if missing
userStories.description: As a developer running fade update on an older project, I want the tests folder created so I'm ready for regression testing
acceptanceCriteria: fade update checks if fade/tests/ directory exists
If missing, creates fade/tests/ directory
Reports 'create: fade/tests/' when created
Reports 'skip: fade/tests/ (already exists)' when present
Does not modify or delete existing fade/tests/ if present

userStories.title: Create fade/tests/run.sh scaffold if missing
userStories.description: As a developer running fade update, I want the test runner scaffold created so regression tests can execute
acceptanceCriteria: fade update checks if fade/tests/run.sh exists
If missing, creates run.sh with same scaffold as fade init (loops PRD-* folders, writes failures to failed.log)
run.sh is created with executable permissions (chmod +x)
Reports 'create: fade/tests/run.sh' when created
Reports 'skip: fade/tests/run.sh (already exists)' when present
Never overwrites existing run.sh even if different from template

userStories.title: Create fade/prd-archive/ folder if missing
userStories.description: As a developer running fade update on an older project, I want the prd-archive folder created so completed PRDs can be archived
acceptanceCriteria: fade update checks if fade/prd-archive/ directory exists
If missing, creates fade/prd-archive/ directory
Reports 'create: fade/prd-archive/' when created
Reports 'skip: fade/prd-archive/ (already exists)' when present
Does not modify or delete existing fade/prd-archive/ if present

userStories.title: Create CLAUDE.md redirect if missing
userStories.description: As a developer using Claude Code, I want CLAUDE.md created so Claude Code finds FADE context automatically
acceptanceCriteria: fade update checks if CLAUDE.md exists in project root
If missing, creates CLAUDE.md with redirect content pointing to FADE.md and fade/prompt.md
Redirect content matches: '# Claude Code Entry Point\n\nRead `FADE.md` for project context and `fade/prompt.md` for execution protocol.'
Reports 'create: CLAUDE.md' when created
Reports 'skip: CLAUDE.md (already exists)' when present
Never overwrites existing CLAUDE.md even if different from template

userStories.title: Summary report of structure check
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a clear summary of what fade update did to my project structure
acceptanceCriteria: fade update shows 'Project Structure Check' section in output
Section appears after CLI and prompt.md updates, before completion
Lists each item checked with create/skip status
Shows count summary: 'N items created, M items already present'
If nothing created, shows 'Project structure up to date'

userStories.title: Structure check runs on all update modes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want structure check to run whether I'm updating CLI, prompt.md, or checking for updates
acceptanceCriteria: Structure check runs on normal 'fade update'
Structure check runs on 'fade update --cli-only'
Structure check output shown in 'fade update --check' (reports what would be created)
In --check mode, structure gaps reported as 'would create: X' without actually creating

technicalNotes.implementation: Add structure check function to cmd_update() after existing CLI and prompt.md update logic
technicalNotes.runShTemplate: Use exact same heredoc template as cmd_init for run.sh scaffold to ensure consistency
technicalNotes.claudeMdTemplate:
# Claude Code Entry Point

Read `FADE.md` for project context and `fade/prompt.md` for execution protocol.
considerations: Must be non-destructive - never overwrite, never delete
Structure check should work even if fade/ folder doesn't exist yet (create it)
Support both contained structure (fade/) and legacy structure (root level)
Keep DRY - extract shared templates/logic with cmd_init if practical
